item.text: Расширенный прогон оборвался; сейчас выведу только диагностические результаты по каждому кейсу, чтобы точно отделить дефект реализации от ошибки в тестовом ожидании.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'tmp=$(mktemp -d)
check_ok() {
  name=$1
  input=$2
  expected=$3
  printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$input" > "$tmp/$name.json"
  actual=$(bun run src/cli.ts plan "$tmp/$name.json" 2>"$tmp/$name.err")
  status=$?
  if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then echo "FAIL_OK_EXIT $name $status $(tr '"'\\n' ' ' < \""'$tmp/$name.err")"; return; fi
  if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then echo "FAIL_OK_VALUE $name"; echo "ACTUAL=$actual"; echo "EXPECTED=$expected"; return; fi
  echo "PASS $name"
}
check_fail() {
  name=$1
  input=$2
  pattern=$3
  printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$input" > "$tmp/$name.json"
  bun run src/cli.ts plan "$tmp/$name.json" >"$tmp/$name.out" 2>"$tmp/$name.err"
  status=$?
  if [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || [ -s "$tmp/$name.out" ] || ! grep -F "$pattern" "$tmp/$name.err" >/dev/null; then echo "FAIL_ERROR $name status=$status stdout=$(tr '"'\\n' ' ' < \""'$tmp/$name.out") stderr=$(tr '"'\\n' ' ' < \""'$tmp/$name.err")"; else echo "PASS $name"; fi
}
check_ok empty '"'{\"tasks\":[]}' '{\"order\":[],\"layers\":[],\"earliest\":{},\"totalDuration\":0,\"criticalPath\":[]}'
check_ok graph '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"build\",\"duration\":3,\"dependsOn\":[\"lint\"]},{\"id\":\"lint\",\"duration\":2},{\"id\":\"test\",\"duration\":3,\"dependsOn\":[\"lint\"]},{\"id\":\"ship\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"build\",\"test\"]},{\"id\":\"zero\",\"duration\":0}]}' '{\"order\":[\"lint\",\"build\",\"test\",\"ship\",\"zero\"],\"layers\":[[\"lint\",\"zero\"],[\"build\",\"test\"],[\"ship\"]],\"earliest\":{\"lint\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":2},\"build\":{\"start\":2,\"finish\":5},\"test\":{\"start\":2,\"finish\":5},\"ship\":{\"start\":5,\"finish\":6},\"zero\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":0}},\"totalDuration\":6,\"criticalPath\":[\"lint\",\"build\",\"ship\"]}'
check_ok tie '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"z\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"b\",\"a\"]},{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":1},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1}]}' '{\"order\":[\"a\",\"b\",\"z\"],\"layers\":[[\"a\",\"b\"],[\"z\"]],\"earliest\":{\"a\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":1},\"b\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":1},\"z\":{\"start\":1,\"finish\":2}},\"totalDuration\":2,\"criticalPath\":[\"a\",\"z\"]}'

check_fail cycle '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"x\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"y\"]},{\"id\":\"y\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"x\"]}]}' 'x -> y -> x'
check_fail missing '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"x\"]}]}' 'unknown dependency'
check_fail duplicate_id '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":2}]}' 'duplicate task id'
check_fail duplicate_dep '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1},{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\",\"a\"]}]}' 'duplicate id'

printf '%s\\n' '{\"tasks\":[]}' > \""'$tmp/base.json"
for args in '"'' 'nope' 'plan' 'plan X Y' 'plan --wat'; do
  set -- "'$args
  bun run src/cli.ts "$@" >"$tmp/cli.out" 2>"$tmp/cli.err"
  status=$?
  if [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || [ -s "$tmp/cli.out" ]; then echo "FAIL_CLI [$args] status=$status"; else echo "PASS cli [$args] $(head -n 1 "$tmp/cli.err")"; fi
done
bun run src/cli.ts plan "$tmp/base.json" > "$tmp/final.out" 2> "$tmp/final.err"
echo "PASS cli-valid status=$? output=$(cat "$tmp/final.out")"
'
